title: verifyDeploymentSnapshot
responsibility: Captures the destination receipt and validates predecessor proof and forward-only commit ancestry.

inputs.name: captureDeploymentTarget.reviewed
inputs.description: A reviewed deployment record containing the plan, configuration fingerprint, project root, optional target, and predecessor receipt. The plan environment and commit select the destination and constrain promotion to the reviewed source and configuration.

inputs.name: captureDeploymentTarget.plugin
inputs.description: A deployment adapter with an id and discover/deploy callbacks. discover(root) supplies the configuration checked against the reviewed fingerprint, so this value cannot be represented in JSON.

inputs.name: verifyDeploymentSnapshot.root
inputs.description: Repository root to validate against the reviewed root and inspect for an isolated source checkout. When it differs from reviewed.root, its Git revision must equal plan.commit and its worktree must be clean.

inputs.name: verifyDeploymentSnapshot.reviewed
inputs.description: A reviewed deployment record containing the plan, configuration fingerprint, project root, optional target, and predecessor receipt. The plan environment and commit select the destination and constrain promotion to the reviewed source and configuration.

inputs.name: verifyDeploymentSnapshot.guard
inputs.description: Snapshot containing the deployment plugin and the destination receipt captured before deployment, or null when no receipt existed. The discovered configuration and current destination must still match this snapshot.

outputs.name: captureDeploymentTarget
outputs.type: Promise<{ target: CloudflareTarget; destination: DeploymentReceipt | null }>
outputs.description: Returns config.targets[plan.environment] and the current receipt for that environment, or null when no receipt is recorded. The target is not separately checked for presence here; predecessor and ancestry checks apply only when those conditions exist.

outputs.name: verifyDeploymentSnapshot
outputs.description: Resolves to undefined after the source, configuration, and destination snapshot checks pass. A different root is also required to match the reviewed commit and have a clean worktree.

errors.name: Reviewed deployment snapshot no longer matches
errors.description: Throws Error when the reviewed configuration changes, a required predecessor proof is absent or mismatched, destination history is not forward-only, an isolated source changes or is dirty, or the destination receipt changes. Rejections from adapter discovery and state or Git reads can also propagate.

errors.name: Deployment fingerprint, predecessor, or history mismatch
errors.description: Throws Error if configuration differs from the reviewed fingerprint, a required predecessor receipt does not prove the prior environment, exact commit, and configuration, or the destination is not an ancestor of the reviewed commit. Adapter discovery, deployment-state reads, and uncaught Git reads may also reject.
